task_output_summary: Generates and repairs Syzkaller test seeds for kernel fuzzing. Seed repair changes test inputs rather than vulnerable software.
query: Target low-frequency syscall and dependency chain
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Syz-program corpus; syscall inverted index; dependencies from manuals/Syzlang
selection_filtering_reranking: Dependency-level program selection; feedback validity filters
evidence_integration: Adaptive user/assistant program examples; syntax/execution feedback repair
models_and_roles: GPT-3.5; GPT-4; Claude-3.5; CodeLlama/Vicuna/Llama-3; tuned CodeLlama-syz
baselines: Syzkaller and six other kernel fuzzers; prompt/dependency ablations
evaluation_protocol: 436 low-frequency syscall targets; three Linux LTS kernels; five 24h fuzzing runs; seed validity and crashes
reported_metrics: Syntax Valid Rate, Context Effective Rate, Overall Effectiveness Rate, program diversity, code coverage, syscall coverage, crash/vulnerability count, unique bugs, token/time cost

task_output_summary: Produces a vulnerable/non-vulnerable judgment for target code using historical vulnerability knowledge. Historical causes and fixes are retrieval context.
query: Code, abstract purpose, and detailed behavior of target function
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Historical vulnerability knowledge item: code/semantics/cause/fix; lexical documents
selection_filtering_reranking: BM25 over three query views; candidate deduplication and RRF
evidence_integration: Sequential knowledge items; check cause and absence of fix
models_and_roles: GPT-4o; Claude Sonnet 3.5; Qwen2.5-Coder-32B; DeepSeek-V2; extended experiment includes DeepSeek-R1
baselines: Basic/CoT prompts; code-level RAG; fine-tuned LLMAO
evaluation_protocol: PairVul vulnerable/fixed pairs; train/test partition; pairwise evaluation
reported_metrics: Pairwise Acc., Balanced Prec., Balanced Rec., human knowledge-quality/usability ratings, manual retrieval-failure diagnosis

task_output_summary: Produces vulnerability judgments, suspicious lines or AST paths, and explanations of vulnerability behavior, prerequisites, triggers, and categories.
query: Predicted suspicious lines/AST paths plus target-code behavior summary
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Five vector views: code, AST, knowledge, line changes, AST changes; UniXCoder-base vectors
selection_filtering_reranking: Dynamic WRRF; LLM reranking; similarity threshold
evidence_integration: Predict-then-retrieve; history-supported staged detection
baselines: CppCheck; FlawFinder; LineVul; SVulD; fine-tuned CodeBERT/UniXCoder/GraphCodeBERT/CodeT5+; DeepSeek
evaluation_protocol: PrimeVul paired: 3789/480/435 pairs train/validation/test; KB and variants training only
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, Pair Acc., BERTScore of retrieved evidence against reference vulnerability descriptions

task_output_summary: Produces similar-code diagnostic analysis, target-code vulnerability analysis, and a final vulnerability judgment.
query: Target function/code snippet
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Big-Vul code functions with CVE descriptions and patches; CodeT5P-110M/FAISS
selection_filtering_reranking: Normalize embeddings; reject 100% identical matches
evidence_integration: Similar-code analysis, target analysis, final validation
baselines: LLMVD; CFGNN; GRACE; VulACLLM; standalone same-backbone models
evaluation_protocol: 1937 held-out NVD-derived C/C++ snippets (1015 vulnerable/922 safe); retrieved cases with 100% similarity skipped
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1

task_output_summary: Produces a VULNERABLE/SAFE judgment, confidence, and a root-cause or risk explanation.
query: Uncertain target function after lightweight screening
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Vulnerable and safe training functions, with embedding, graph, and AST representations.
selection_filtering_reranking: Dense recall and graph, lexical Jaccard, and AST reranking for uncertain functions.
evidence_integration: One vulnerable and one safe demonstration condition the final judgment and explanation.
baselines: Pure LLM; pure GNN; pure Transformer; without ICL; GRACE published results
evaluation_protocol: Devign and Reveal; cases from training only; rerank weights tuned Devign validation, fixed on Reveal; five seeds
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, AUC, stage-processing ratio, threshold/retrieval-size sensitivity

task_output_summary: Produces vulnerability-category and CWE predictions through router and detector agents. Supporting explanations are not independently evaluated analysis deliverables.
query: Target-code SCALE representation; category-specific router/detector queries
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Training-set SCALE examples; UniXCoder vectors in FAISS
selection_filtering_reranking: Global router retrieval; contrastive positives/clean/hard negatives; allocated budgets
evidence_integration: Coarse-to-fine router and detectors; evolved role-specific prompts
models_and_roles: GPT-4o execution; Claude Opus 4.5 prompt evolution
baselines: GPT-4o; LLMVulExp; fine-tuned code models; GNN baselines
evaluation_protocol: PrimeVul held-out evaluation; KB from training set; training sample itself excluded during offline prompt evolution
reported_metrics: Prec., Rec., F1, category-routing Recall@k, tail/few-shot F1, coverage, Gini coefficient

task_output_summary: Produces CWE-to-line findings and generated dynamic tests, traces, and verification results that confirm, refute, or revise static findings.
query: CFG/CPG-derived target chunk and local vulnerability context
knowledge_unit_representation_index: LocalVulDB code/record chunks; vector similarity; CFG/CPG slices
selection_filtering_reranking: Chunk overlap; top-k=5; cosine; threshold; enabled reranking
evidence_integration: Static detector plus PAL-generated sandbox tests; judge aggregation
models_and_roles: Qwen3-8B default; Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and Seed-Coder-8B compared
baselines: Fortify; SpotBugs; neural/LLM detection baselines; fine-tuning and component ablations
evaluation_protocol: Random 8:1:1 split with no sample overlap; short and custom long Java datasets; static/dynamic validation
benchmarks: MegaVul, Juliet Java, custom long-code dataset
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, FPR, FNR, inference time

task_output_summary: Generates API test sequences for differential fuzzing and discovers crashes or inconsistent behavior. Execution serves the discovery workflow.
query: LLM-generated tested-API functionality and similar APIs
knowledge_unit_representation_index: GitHub issue vulnerability knowledge; text-embedding-v3; Chroma/HNSW
selection_filtering_reranking: Cosine ANN candidate selection
evidence_integration: Role-based knowledge-conditioned API seed generation
models_and_roles: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B offline KB; DeepSeek-V3 online generation; Qwen-2.5-32B in PaddlePaddle bug-discovery experiment
baselines: TitanFuzz; FuzzGPT; retrieved comparator results from papers
evaluation_protocol: PyTorch/TensorFlow/Paddle fuzzing; coverage/valid seeds/bugs
reported_metrics: Detected bug count, line/code coverage, API coverage, valid seed rate

task_output_summary: Produces a vulnerability-related issue decision and a CWE identifier from rich-text issue reports.
query: OCR/CAST-converted rich-text issue report
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Historical vulnerability-associated records and textual reasoning graphs
selection_filtering_reranking: TF-IDF thresholds for knowledge, graph records and graph selection
evidence_integration: Selected reasoning graph generates target-specific guidance prompt
baselines: General code/text classifiers; standalone LLM and reasoning baselines; component ablations
evaluation_protocol: 973572 issue reports; historical 60% and targets 40%; real-world emerging issue study
reported_metrics: Issue identification: Prec., Rec., F1, AUROC, AUPRC; CWE-ID prediction: Macro-P, Macro-R, Macro-F1; average time cost

task_output_summary: Produces web-code vulnerability findings, data-flow and exploitability analysis, and proofs of vulnerability.
query: Target project source lines
knowledge_unit_representation_index: GHSA vulnerable lines embedded with bge in language-specific FAISS; condensed descriptions and CVE IDs attached as metadata
selection_filtering_reranking: Similarity thresholds; relaxed fallback; suspicious line shortlist
evidence_integration: Retrieval-guided collaborative data-flow and exploitability dialogue
baselines: Embedding variants; standalone/tool agent comparisons
evaluation_protocol: 323 nonoverlapping CVE recall cases; confirmed precision/rare-CWE/OOD; 8 real projects
benchmarks: CVEfixes , manually confirmed precision benchmark, OOD rare-CWE test, GitHub web projects
evaluation_context: PHP, Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript
reported_metrics: Rec., Prec., Acc., Silhouette coefficient, time, dialogue rounds, cost-effectiveness, number of CVEs found

task_output_summary: Produces repository findings, vulnerable flows, root-cause reports, proofs of concept, and supporting repair recommendations or patches. Mitigation is not a separately evaluated principal endpoint.
query: Project dependency IDs/versions and suspect sinks
knowledge_unit_representation_index: NVD/OSV/GHSA/Snyk and repository/issue/PoC records; CodeQL paths
selection_filtering_reranking: Relevance, credibility, content-quality scores; primary/fork source priorities
evidence_integration: CVE retrieval, PoC/verification, CodeQL/flow-review agents; ReAct/Re3
baselines: CodeQL and IRIS
evaluation_protocol: Real Java repository study; sink/path/vulnerability manual evidence and CVE assignments
reported_metrics: Detected sink count, detected vulnerability count, token consumption

task_output_summary: Produces function-level vulnerability classifications. Retrieved callers, callees, types, and generated summaries provide detection context.
query: Target function, user-defined callees/callers/types
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Repository definitions; Tree-sitter; gtags/ctags; generated function summaries
selection_filtering_reranking: LLM relevance filtering/ranking of callees and types
evidence_integration: Structured repository context; understand then reason stepwise
baselines: CodeT5; LineVul; CodeBERT/UniXCoder and newer detectors
evaluation_protocol: FFmpeg/QEMU and DiverseVul; 8:1:1 split; training/test deduplication; extra random-split significance runs
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, cost per LLM call, human summary validity

task_output_summary: Produces vulnerability classifications using code features and retrieval-conditioned descriptions. The generated descriptions are classifier inputs.
query: Target smart-contract code
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Audit/report text; BERT vectors in FAISS; generated semantic descriptions
selection_filtering_reranking: Nearest report retrieval
evidence_integration: Retrieved report in description prompt; low-rank bilinear code/text feature fusion
baselines: GNN/CNN feature baselines; LLM prompting; GPTLens; GPT-5/Claude/DeepSeek comparison
evaluation_protocol: Smart-contract datasets; K-fold cross-validation; detection and description quality
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, TP/TN/FP/FN, BLEU for code-description quality

task_output_summary: Produces contract vulnerability judgments, root causes, trigger and risk descriptions, and supporting remediation guidance.
query: LLM-extracted contract purpose and behavior
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Functional-semantics/cause/remedy KG; text-embedding-3-large 3072D vectors
selection_filtering_reranking: Top-30 embedding recall; BM25 lexical reranking; KG paths
evidence_integration: Top-k knowledge injected into fine-tuned detector; explanation/fix suggestion
baselines: No-RAG same models; Slither; Mythril
evaluation_protocol: SolidiFI and SmartBugs-Curated; same-model RAG/non-RAG comparisons; GPT-4o description/fix rubric
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, rubric-based description/fix quality score

task_output_summary: Produces contract vulnerability labels and reports describing locations, manifestations, root causes, risks, impacts, and mitigation recommendations.
query: Target contract token/chunk sequence
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Contract vulnerability case corpus; sparse BM25 and dense vector channels
selection_filtering_reranking: Parallel BM25 and dense retrieval; prediction-vector fusion
evidence_integration: Parallel SLoRA LLM detection and retrieval-based neighbor voting. A learned verification module fuses predictions. The CoT reporter consumes the fused result and processed target contract.
baselines: LLM-only; BM25-RAG; dense-RAG; QLoRA/QALoRA variants
evaluation_protocol: SC_UEE and ScrawlD; single- and multi-label evaluation
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, inference time, GPU memory usage

task_output_summary: Generates executable exploit templates, transaction sequences, and fuzzing inputs for vulnerability discovery.
query: Target functions mapped to SWC classes; contract semantics
knowledge_unit_representation_index: SWC/DAppSCAN knowledge chunks; embeddings; function/ABI/transaction constraints
selection_filtering_reranking: SWC class filtering then semantic score
evidence_integration: Context plus contract generates transaction-aware fuzzing templates
baselines: MuFuzz
evaluation_protocol: D2 and Soli-Audit 65 contracts each; coverage/recall/resource comparisons
reported_metrics: Branch coverage, vulnerability recall, average test cases per contract

task_output_summary: Generates transaction sequences and parameters and reports fuzzing discoveries. External expert confirmation is part of evaluation.
query: Function context for parameters and transaction sequence
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Audit report chunks; FAISS vector store
selection_filtering_reranking: Top-k cosine-similarity chunks
evidence_integration: Static/data-flow/semantic context plus RAG; code/input/feedback agents
baselines: Existing smart-contract fuzzers
evaluation_protocol: SoliAudit and Etherscan; single/cross-contract campaigns; manual vulnerability validation
reported_metrics: Code coverage, branch coverage, detection accuracy, validated vulnerability count

task_output_summary: Produces a vulnerable/secure classification by fusing structural features with semantic features derived from an LLM report.
query: Target smart-contract feature patterns
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Vulnerability snippets/patterns; cosine similarity; contract graph features
selection_filtering_reranking: Feature-pattern matching with cosine similarity
evidence_integration: LLM semantic report and GNN structural features; co-attention
baselines: Peculiar; GPTLens; LLM-SmartAudit; GNNs; TF-IDF/BM25 retrieval ablations
evaluation_protocol: ESC and Qian et al. smart-contract data; 8:2 train/test; classifier metrics and retrieval/feature ablations
reported_metrics: Acc., Prec., Rec., F1, detection time, monetary cost

task_output_summary: Produces multilabel vulnerability predictions, explanatory subgraphs, triggering statements, and root-cause or path evidence.
query: Textual critical node/edge/subgraph context
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Solidity/EVM and audit-document chunks, represented with bge embeddings in Milvus.
selection_filtering_reranking: Top-10 recall followed by cross-encoder reranking to retain three passages.
evidence_integration: Retrieved passages support node/edge semantic enrichment before learned feature fusion.
baselines: No-enrichment and causal/feature ablations; existing graph/contract detectors
evaluation_protocol: 80:20 multilabel-stratified SoliAudit/CGT; DAppSCAN and LLMAV OOD only; address dedup; five runs
reported_metrics: Acc./Jaccard, Prec., Rec., F1, Attack Success Rate (ASR), Mean Statement Precision (MSP), Mean Statement Recall (MSR), Mean Intersection over Union (MIoU), inference time

task_output_summary: Produces validated audit findings, locations, severity, business impact, exploitability and root-cause analysis, and mitigation recommendations.
query: Audit task/contract security query
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Security-document chunks of 512 tokens with 128-token overlap, encoded with Sentence-BERT.
selection_filtering_reranking: Top-5 cosine matches, threshold 0.72 with a 0.68 fallback, and optional MMR (λ=0.7).
evidence_integration: Retrieved context with source metadata supports audit planning and execution alongside static evidence and validator feedback.
baselines: Traditional analyzers; instruction and reasoning LLMs; no-RAG/static/plan ablations
evaluation_protocol: SmartBugs-Curated; Code4rena; Sherlock; 13-CVE/DeFi validation; accuracy/ranking/cost
benchmarks: Standard Vulnerability Set, SmartBugs-Curated, Code4rena, Sherlock, CVE Set
reported_metrics: Precision, Recall, F1, Top-N accuracy, MRR, MAP, average outputs, average steps, cost, execution time

task_output_summary: Produces CVSS v3 severity classes and reasoning about exploitability, impact, attack vectors, privileges, and CWE context.
query: Target code and CVE description
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Historical code+description+severity records; CodeBERT and CoSENT embeddings
selection_filtering_reranking: Weighted bimodal similarity; top-k examples
evidence_integration: Dynamic few-shot CoT using CWE/CVSS/impact/exploitability examples
baselines: Code-based, description-based and bimodal severity classifiers
evaluation_protocol: Stratified 80% knowledge/10% validation/10% test; index only knowledge partition; Macro-F1/MCC
reported_metrics: Acc., F1, MCC, token usage

task_output_summary: Answers vulnerability questions using NVD descriptions, dates, exploitability, impact, and severity information.
query: User vulnerability question
knowledge_unit_representation_index: NVD JSON text chunks; TF-IDF index
selection_filtering_reranking: TF-IDF similarity; dedup/record cleanup
evidence_integration: Shared grounded query+context prompt across models
baselines: Same fixed retrieval pipeline across LLMs; embedding technique comparisons
evaluation_protocol: Curated question batches; factual/error/omission/cost metrics
reported_metrics: Accuracy by batch/question type, hallucination rate, omission rate, processing failure/error rate, cost per correct answer, efficiency score

task_output_summary: Produces exploitation and mitigation answers, rationales, source provenance, and self-critique for a specified CVE.
query: CVE ID plus exploitation or mitigation question
knowledge_unit_representation_index: NVD, CWE, and linked source documents, summarized for answers and embedded as raw chunks for provenance.
selection_filtering_reranking: Source traversal for answer context and dense top-10 raw-chunk retrieval for provenance assessment.
evidence_integration: Summaries condition exploitation/mitigation answers. Raw chunks condition subsequent self-critique.
baselines: Prompt-only; vector-chunking retrieval; summary/retrieval variants
evaluation_protocol: 482 critical 2024 CVEs; exploitation/mitigation QA and TP/FP/FN provenance
reported_metrics: LLM self-critique TP/FP/FN, accuracy/TP rate for exploitation and mitigation, response–evidence ROUGE-L and cosine similarity, guardrail/refusal count

task_output_summary: Maps CVEs to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and produces exploitation and impact descriptions with structured answers and reasons.
query: Entities/questions derived from CVE description
knowledge_unit_representation_index: VDM-M/ATT&CK knowledge graph; entity/relation records
selection_filtering_reranking: Iterative depth-first graph query; LLM path scoring/reflection
evidence_integration: Identification→querying→scoring→questioning→reflection
baselines: Plain/CoT/self-consistency; vector LlamaIndex; DATER/LLM-KG/ToG; NER baselines
evaluation_protocol: 2018 mapping samples; 1247 NER; comparison dataset 8:1:1; manual cleaned labels
benchmarks: CVE database, named-entity recognition (NER), and comparison datasets
reported_metrics: Precision, Recall, Micro-F1, Macro-F1, NER Precision, NER Recall, NER F1

task_output_summary: Produces conflict-resolved CVE answers and updated information, including old and new values and change descriptions.
query: User CVE question with conflicting historical/new knowledge
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Official CVE/NVD parent documents; semantic subchunks; BM25 and vector index
selection_filtering_reranking: Parent-document/semantic chunking; weighted vector (0.25) and BM25 (0.75) ensemble; synonym/subquestion query variants
evidence_integration: Stage I retrieval/augmentation; Stage II preference optimization and answer generation
models_and_roles: DPO-Llama3-8B and DPO-Mistral-8B; GPT-4o-mini in no-DPO RAG variant
baselines: No-prompt/prompt-only Claude-3.5-Haiku and Gemini-2.0-Flash-Exp; naive RAG; no-DPO variant
evaluation_protocol: CVE knowledge-conflict QA; RAGAS context/faithfulness and lexical answer metrics
benchmarks: CVE knowledge-conflict dataset from official CVE GitHub data and NVD API
reported_metrics: Answer correctness, answer relevance, answer similarity, faithfulness, context precision, context recall, BLEU, ROUGE-L

task_output_summary: Produces vulnerability representations, container environments, exploit scripts, test cases, execution logs, and reproduction results for known CVEs. Iterative repair changes reproduction artifacts.
query: CVE ID/description, referenced sources and missing reproduction requirements
knowledge_unit_representation_index: CVE links, commits, PoCs/blogs/advisories; web/file tools
selection_filtering_reranking: Reference traversal; iterative failure-driven environment/PoC correction
evidence_integration: Condition extraction→Docker environment→PoC execution→repair loop
baselines: Alternative LLMs and pipeline component/reproduction comparisons
evaluation_protocol: 102 CVEs from 55 projects/9 languages; 71 reproduced; executable container validation
reported_metrics: Reproduction success rate, failure rate, step-level success/failure rate, iteration count, execution time

task_output_summary: Maps known vulnerability descriptions to affected software packages using retrieved package documentation and local name correction.
query: Vulnerability description within a specified ecosystem
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Package names and descriptions within the target ecosystem.
selection_filtering_reranking: TF-IDF recall followed by BERT reranking of 512 candidates.
evidence_integration: Selected package descriptions condition name generation, followed by local name correction.
baselines: FastXML; LightXML; Chronos; VulLibMiner; non-RAG/SFT/ICL variants
evaluation_protocol: 9570 GitHub Advisory vulnerabilities (Java2789/JS3193/Python2237/Go1351); chronological 3:1:1; Precision/Recall@k; 34 accepted advisory links
benchmarks: VulLib and GHSA-derived JavaScript, Python, and Go records
reported_metrics: Precision@k, Recall@k, F1@k (k=1,2,3), runtime, accepted advisory corrections

task_output_summary: Produces repair recommendations and code fixes, with supporting vulnerability locations, issue descriptions, and root-cause information.
query: Target vulnerable code and CWE/CVE identifiers
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Vulnerable/fixed code and CWE/CVE fields, with sparse and dense representations.
selection_filtering_reranking: Vanilla, metadata-aware, and field-segmented retrieval configurations.
evidence_integration: Retrieved repair examples and chunk-level analyses condition code repair and recommendations.
baselines: Zero-shot same backbones; vanilla retrieval; prior repair methods; exact/reference metrics
evaluation_protocol: CWE/BigVul/CVEfixes; static-analysis repair assessment and LLM-judge rubrics
reported_metrics: CodeBLEU, chrF, RUBY, EM, manual retrieval/repair inspection, fixed-file and resolved-issue rates, LLM-as-judge scores

task_output_summary: Generates and refines smart-contract patches and reports compilation and Slither-based repair outcomes.
query: Vulnerable function vector and signature constraints
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Contract functions and their relations, with CodeBERT representations.
selection_filtering_reranking: Top-50 semantic neighbors, signature compatibility, usage-based trust, and clone-diversity filtering.
evidence_integration: Selected repair knowledge conditions patch generation, followed by compilation and static-check feedback.
baselines: DirectFix; LogicRepair; SelfRefine; standard RAG
evaluation_protocol: 200 contracts; hash dedup against 5000 KB; compilation and Slither-based elimination, not functional equivalence
reported_metrics: CPR, ERR, ORR, fixed-contract count

task_output_summary: Generates and purifies patch diffs using retrieved vulnerable-fixed function pairs and mined AST edit patterns.
query: Target vulnerable function
knowledge_unit_representation_index: Vulnerable–fixed function pairs, indexed with BM25 and a CodeT5-initialized, fine-tuned dense passage retriever.
selection_filtering_reranking: The target vulnerable function supplies the query. Weighted BM25 and dense scores rank historical repair pairs.
evidence_integration: Target code and its AST are combined with retrieved patch diffs and mined edit patterns to generate a patch diff.
baselines: TFix; VRepair; VulRepair; VulMaster; VQM; prompt/LoRA/code LM baselines
evaluation_protocol: Dedup BigVul/CVEfixes; random splits there and D2A; chronological post-backbone CVED; CWEVAL functional/security tests
benchmarks: BigVul, CVEfixes, D2A, CVED, CWEVAL-BENCH, ReposVul
reported_metrics: EM, BLEU, CodeBLEU, func@k, func-sec@k, expert-rated retrieval failure, retrieved-case cosine similarity, patch performance under retrieval corruption

task_output_summary: Matches target code to CVEs, verifies vulnerability presence, explains causes, generates patched code, and revisits it through verifier feedback.
query: Target-code lexical/context/data-flow features
knowledge_unit_representation_index: CVE vulnerable/fixed code and descriptions; context vectors; DFG symbols
selection_filtering_reranking: Keyword/Jaccard/fuzzy plus cosine plus DFG-symbol unified trainable score
evidence_integration: CVE matching, vulnerability verification, and patch generation. One-shot CoT prompting and verifier feedback condition subsequent generation.
baselines: Zero-shot same backbones; VSP; transformed-code robustness variants
evaluation_protocol: 75 recent high-severity CVEs; 525 reimplemented snippets (375 in code-reimplementation evaluation); 70:15:15 similarity-model split; verifier and patch accuracy
evaluation_context: Linux kernel, Chromium, and related C/C++ systems
reported_metrics: CVE matching accuracy, vulnerability verification accuracy/F1, joint CoT+vulnerability accuracy/F1, patch accuracy, patch-verification loop count, cost
